title: Hades
description: Hades is an action roguelike from Supergiant Games in which Zagreus fights through the Underworld using different weapons, divine boons, and persistent upgrades. It combines highly responsive combat with strong writing, memorable characters, and a structure that makes repeated play rewarding. This file represents the Nintendo Switch 1 product entry.
